data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at 1 January (prior year comparative) was $16,289.6k (16.2896m USD). The report does not disclose a single gross prior-year reserve movement figure; it provides gross claims liabilities by underwriting year (2018, 2019, 2020) and notes that the 2018 year closed with a small return while the 2019 year has been impacted by adverse claims experience arising from the COVID-19 pandemic. No explicit gross prior-year strengthening or release amount is stated in the notes, so no quantified prior-year development could be extracted from the disclosed reconciliations or tables.
raw_causal_phrases: The 2018 year of account has closes with a return on capacity of 3.2%.
The 2019 year of account currently forecasts closing with a return on capacity of 2.0% despite having already been impacted by adverse claims experience arising from the COVID-19 global pandemic.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, prior year comparative). No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' or a gross prior-year development amount was found in the disclosed notes; the technical provisions note gives per-underwriting-year gross claims liabilities but no reconciliation that isolates prior-year (<=2018) movement. A gross claims development triangle suitable for computing prior-year development was not present (only per-year ultimate and liabilities by UW year). Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. All amounts are reported in the native currency (USD) and in millions.
